purpose: Measure one fixed endpoint geometry and fixed research level; do not generalize it to other inserter endpoints.

setup.supply_conditions: Iron plates are available without supply starvation; source extraction is counted.
setup.removal_conditions: The destination steel chest is the collector and its count is read before clearing it after each window.

power_control.circuit_state: no circuit wires or enable condition

expected_not_observed: This is chest-to-chest only at inserter-capacity-bonus 0. It is not evidence for belt endpoints, another research level, or another inserter type.
